acceptance_cases.expect: card resolves exact authorized CSW-07 document/branch/revision resume target and reauthorizes before opening
CSW-03 idea status is projected without automatic promotion or lifecycle mutation
CSW-06 OpenThread/candidate remains advisory and respects dismiss/snooze/changed-evidence behavior
reason/evidence/actions come from owning workflow and do not become objective story-quality scoring
recent card loses protected preview/title/detail according to visibility policy and cannot bypass reauthorization
claim applies only to authorized visible usage scope and does not imply hidden Campaigns do not use the material
counts and relationships are computed after visibility filtering and reveal no protected Campaign existence/cardinality/details
stable identity resolves current target or safe changed/archived/unavailable/recovery state without guessing
palette routes to owning-domain command; owning domain rechecks authorization/validation and required confirmation
user can inspect applicable context, sources and task; generated output remains candidate/advisory and cannot promote/publish/mutate truth
unauthorized Campaign/private material is excluded before context assembly and cannot be inferred through related-work results
resume, search, ideas, guided workflows, continuity, writing, reuse and Workshop organization remain useful
APW-05 Sandbox session is visibly noncanonical and never presented as Campaign progress/reusable truth before explicit save-out
cached cards are marked stale/read-only as required and do not broaden search or execute connectivity-required authoritative commands
metadata is passive until a separately authorized scheduling feature/user request exists; no default recurring nagging
item stays suppressed unless explicit user action or materially changed evidence makes resurfacing appropriate
all surfaces, filters, context labels, command actions, attention reasons and related/usage summaries are operable via mobile/keyboard/screen reader without color/graph dependence
